name: seal
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,datetime
lane=Path.cwd()
def write(n,v):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
excluded=['hash-manifest.json','verification.json','seal.receipt.json','seal.output.txt']
files={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in lane.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name not in excluded}
m={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'algorithm':'sha256','files':files,'exclusions':excluded,'closure':'Only lane-local top-level files; no source body acquired and no subdirectory created. Manifest/verification excluded for self-reference; final seal receipt/output generated after child completion. All four earlier run receipt JSONs plus original bootstrap receipt included.'}
write('hash-manifest.json',m)
saved=json.loads((lane/'hash-manifest.json').read_text());bad=[n for n,h in saved['files'].items() if hashlib.sha256((lane/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h]
fb=json.loads((lane/'frozen-before.json').read_text());fa=json.loads((lane/'frozen-after.json').read_text())
write('verification.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((lane/'hash-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files_verified':len(files),'mismatches':bad,'frozen_before':fb,'frozen_after':fa,'receipt_names_hashed':[n for n in files if n.endswith('receipt.json')],'limits':'Final sealing receipt/output excluded explicitly; hashes validate preservation, not scientific novelty or full resource compliance.'})
assert not bad
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files_verified':len(files),'mismatches':bad,'frozen_after':fa,'decision':'337290 precise HOLD; 52/60 beyond39; credit0'}))
